value.deck: Imagine an AI helper that can now work with your whole team at once in Microsoft Teams, making group projects much smoother.
shortVersion: GitHub Copilot is like a smart assistant that helps people with their work. Before, it mostly helped one person at a time. Now, it can work with many people together.

This new feature, called "shared agentic work," means your team can all talk to the AI helper at the same time within Microsoft Teams. Everyone can give the AI instructions and see its progress, just like working on a shared document.
This makes using AI a team effort. Instead of just one person getting help, the whole team can use the AI to tackle tasks, review its suggestions, and get things done faster as a group.
value.plainLanguage: An AI helper called GitHub Copilot can now work with your entire team in Microsoft Teams, allowing everyone to collaborate on tasks with the AI together.

keyTerms.meaning: This is an artificial intelligence (AI) assistant that helps people with different tasks, like writing computer code or answering questions.
This is a popular online tool where people can chat, have video calls, and work together on projects from different places.
Think of an AI agent as a smart computer program that can understand a task you give it and then try to complete that task on its own, like a very clever digital assistant.
This is when a group of people works together with one of these AI agents. Everyone in the team can tell the AI what to do and see what it's doing, making it a team effort with the AI.

value.whyItMatters: This matters because it changes AI from a personal helper into a tool that entire teams can use together, making group projects more efficient and collaborative.
watchNext: See how teams start using AI to solve problems and create new things together.
Look for more ways AI tools are designed to help groups of people collaborate better.
Keep an eye on updates from tools like GitHub Copilot and Microsoft Teams as they add more team-focused AI features.
